item.title: Salem University, Pierpont College sign memorandum of understanding
item.description: Salem University will accept up to 90 transfer credits towards bachelor’s programs and consider prior learning, training, and certifications toward degree completion from students and graduates of Pierpont.

item.title: WVU professor discusses what might cause accidents on I-79
item.description: After Monday's fatal wreck and traffic jam, some commuters may be wondering what factors go into these traffic accidents. 12 News spoke with David Martinelli, a civil engineering professor at WVU, who shared what some of these factors could be.

item.title: Bridgeport native reflects on year as Mountaineer mascot alternate
item.description: Being the mascot keeps Morgan’s schedule booked and busy. As she wraps up her year, she has made 130 appearances, setting a new record of appearances for any alternate Mountaineer and passing the previous record of 87 within her first five months.

item.title: Morgantown Municipal IDs face potential roadblock with legislature bill
item.description: It amends state code to include the following provision: “No municipality may, by ordinance, charter, or otherwise, authorize the use of a municipal identification card or any other locally issued identification as a valid form of voter identification if such document is not otherwise authorized by state law for use in a statewide election.”
